title: cohortmatch: statistical matching for cohort studies at scale
description: Statistical matching for cohort studies: nearest-neighbor and optimal matching on propensity scores or covariate distances, propensity subclassification, coarsened exact matching, and risk-set matching, with calipers, exact constraints, balance diagnostics, and treatment-effect estimation. Validated against R's MatchIt; scales to biobank-sized cohorts.
